title.zh: 从青色格子里取出绿色
title.en: Read Green from a Cyan Tile

brief.zh: 一块看起来是青色的像素，也有自己的绿色亮度。
brief.en: A pixel that looks cyan still has a green reading.

concept.zh: 像素的外观由三个通道一起组成。单个通道可以单独读取。
concept.en: All three channels create the pixel’s appearance. You can read each channel on its own.

hints.zh: 第 0 行从左往右数，青色格子的 x 是 4。
hints.en: Counting from the left in row 0, the cyan tile has x = 4.

prompt.zh: 在 (4, 0) 只读取绿色通道。
prompt.en: Read only the green channel at (4, 0).
